name: Lithuania

train.sum: Vilnius Railway Station (Geležinkelio g. 16) is the single main station, south of the Old Town and next to the Bus Station. LTG Link runs trains to Kaunas, Klaipeda, Siauliai, Trakai and Visaginas, a short shuttle to the airport, and one daily train to Riga that connects on to Tallinn.
train.sched: Kaunas has up to 15 trains a day and Klaipeda up to 6. Trakai, Visaginas and the Riga and Warsaw links run a few times a day. LTG Link fares were halved in April and May 2026 and are back to normal dynamic pricing.
tickets: Dynamic pricing: booking early can save up to 40 percent. Last-minute tickets can cost up to 10 percent more
Vilnius to Kaunas: usually 5 to 10 EUR
Vilnius to Riga: 9.60 to 24 EUR in second class, 34 EUR in first class. Seat reservation is compulsory
Vilnius to Tallinn: about 39 EUR on one through ticket
Vilnius to Warsaw: from about 16 EUR, standard fare about 29 EUR, with a change at Mockava
Parents travelling with children get 50 percent off on weekdays too
Airport shuttle: 0.90 EUR
train.tip: Book at ltglink.lt or in the LTG Link app a few days ahead for the lowest fare. International and some domestic trains need a seat reservation.
link: Vilnius Airport: train to the city
buy: ltglink.lt or the LTG Link app
On the train. Check ltglink.lt for the on-board price before you rely on it
Seat reservation is compulsory on international trains
Riga and Tallinn trains can also be booked on vivi.lv and elron.ee

destinations.note: About 16 shuttle trains a day. Fare 0.90 EUR
Up to 15 trains a day. Slower trains take up to 1 h 40 min
Border station where you change for Polish trains
Up to 6 trains a day. In summer a train and bus service continues to Nida and Palanga
Daily direct train via Siauliai and Jelgava. Seat reservation is compulsory

destinations.operator: LTG Link and a Polish train
destinations.note: Not direct: leaves about 06:27, change at Mockava
Not direct: daily on one through ticket. The Riga train continues to Valga, where you change

tram.sum: Vilnius has no metro and no trams. Buses and trolleybuses run on one ticket system run by Vilniaus viesasis transportas (JUDU), and trolleybuses use the same tickets as buses.
tram.sched: Buses and trolleybuses run from early morning until around midnight. Nine night bus routes (N1 to N9) run on Friday and Saturday nights, about every 30 minutes after midnight.
tickets: 30-minute ticket: 1.00 EUR
60-minute ticket: 1.25 EUR. Transfers are allowed within the time
1-day ticket: 7.50 EUR
3-day ticket: 13.50 EUR
30-day ticket: 38 EUR
Contactless bank card: each tap buys a 60-minute ticket at 1.25 EUR
Vilnius Pass 24 hours plus public transport: 46.50 EUR
tram.tip: Every ticket must be activated on board, even one bought in advance. Tap your bank card on the green validator or activate the ticket in the app.
buy: Tap a contactless bank card or phone on the green validator (60 minutes, 1.25 EUR)
m.Ticket or Trafi app: 30 and 60 minute and day tickets, activated on board
Vilniečio (JUDU) card, 1.50 EUR, topped up at Narvesen, Lietuvos spauda, Maxima, Rimi and Aibe shops and JUDU service centres
Self-service terminals only top up an existing card
Not possible from the driver. Drivers do not sell tickets and cash is not accepted
Without a valid, activated ticket you can pay a 15 EUR inspection ticket on the spot, or be fined 16 to 30 EUR

bus.sum: City buses and trolleybuses use the tickets above. Long-distance coaches leave from Vilnius Bus Station (Sodu g. 22), next to the railway station, with Lux Express, FlixBus, Ecolines, TOKS and Kautra.
bus.sched: City buses run from early morning to around midnight. Kaunas has about 14 direct coaches a day taking about 1 h 30 min, and Riga takes about 4 h 15 min.
tickets: City bus and trolleybus: same fares as above, 1.25 EUR for 60 minutes
Night buses N1 to N9: normal fares
Vilnius to Kaunas coach: from about 10 EUR when booked early
Vilnius to Riga coach: from about 5 EUR when booked early, often 13 EUR or more on the day
bus.tip: Trains are about as fast to Kaunas, so compare both. For Riga and Tallinn, check coach and train prices for your date.
buy: City buses: tap a contactless card on the validator, or use the m.Ticket or Trafi app
Not possible from the driver, and cash is not accepted on city buses
Long-distance coaches: online with Omio or the operator, or at the Bus Station

airport.sum: Vilnius Airport (VNO) is about 6 km south of the centre, next to the railway line. A short train, three bus routes and a night bus all reach the centre in under 20 minutes.
airport.sched: The airport train takes 7 to 8 minutes to the railway station and runs about 16 times a day between roughly 07:00 and 19:30. Buses 1, 2 and 88 run every 20 to 30 minutes, and express bus 3G about every 10 minutes. Night bus 88N runs from about 22:30 to 05:30.
tickets: Train to Vilnius Railway Station: 0.90 EUR
Buses 1, 2, 88 and 3G: 1.25 EUR for 60 minutes by contactless card
Official taxi to the Old Town: about 10 EUR
Bolt to the centre: about 5 to 8 EUR, shown before you book
airport.tip: The train is the fastest option but has few departures. For late flights use night bus 88N or Bolt.
buy: Train: ltglink.lt, LTG Link app, Perlas terminals, the ticket machine on the platform outside the terminal, or on the train
Buses: tap a contactless bank card on the validator on board
Bus tickets are also sold at the Narvesen shop at the airport
Taxis from the rank, or Bolt in the app

metro.note: Vilnius has no metro and no trams. Trolleybuses and buses cover the city, and a short train links the airport.
lines: Trolleybuses and buses on one ticket
Express bus 3G links the airport and the centre
Night buses N1 to N9 run on Friday and Saturday nights
Train shuttle between the airport and Vilnius Railway Station

tips: Tap a contactless bank card on every bus and trolleybus. The tap buys and activates a 60-minute ticket.
Drivers do not sell tickets, so board with a card or the app ready.
Ticket inspectors are frequent. The on-the-spot inspection ticket costs 15 EUR and fines run 16 to 30 EUR.
The Old Town is walkable. Use buses and trolleybuses for the Bus Station, outer districts and the airport.
